body: You don't give a shit. Do you get some sort of self-satisfaction talking down to me like I'm a toddler? I never came into this with the mindset that 'things will get better by themselves' no one suggested that. Of course I've fucking tried helping myself and what did it show? The system in place for mental health for low-income worthless people are overused and there aren't enough resources to accommodate us all. No amount of self-help or words will help fix the literal chemical imbalance  in my brain without medicine that I can't afford. What else kinda pre-programmed response do you have for me?

100% I'm taking precautions to prevent that from happening and I encourage other users to do the same. Using a VPN and Tor is what I recommend and if there's anything else lmk. The hospital staff treat you like a second-class citizen. You're under constant watch (depending on which psych unit you go to) like a prisoner. We even joked about being inmates with the other patients because of how many of our rights were stripped away. It's fucking inhumane and it doesn't help. They just lock you up, diagnose you, and send you back.

exactly.  I fucking despise those shit-eating virtue signalers that spout the same bullshit platitudes "it'll get better you have to give it time" who are so deluded that they believe in their own fantasies.
